products.name: Tiny Acres
products.pitch: A cozy puzzle a day, in a painted 3D countryside.
products.description: One shared puzzle a day: match the edges, and your acre grows into one little landscape. And Worlds: whole landscapes to piece together. No lives, no timers.

hero_image.alt: Tiny Acres: a little floating island with cottages, a windmill, a lake with a sailing boat, wheat fields and sheep.

share_image.alt: Tiny Acres, a cozy puzzle a day: a finished acre in painted 3D, its woods, lakes, fields, cottages and snowy peaks running on into one another.

update.name: The 3D look
update.summary: every acre and every world, redrawn in painted 3D
update.text: Every tile, every world and the home screen are redrawn in a painted 3D look: woods, wheat fields, lakes, cottages and snow-capped peaks, with a living countryside behind your board. Close a forest and birds lift from the trees; close a lake and a fish leaps; close a village and its windows light up. Each day's acre now has a cozy name of its own, like Hazel Corner. And from Tuesday 24 November, every day's acre has all five terrains, and every day is just as friendly, so any day is a good day to start.

channels.cta: Get it on the App Store

channels.label: Play in your browser
channels.cta: Play today's acre in your browser

screenshots.alt: One cozy puzzle a day: Today's acre, Oak Haven, part-way in 3D: a forest tile held over its cell beside a lake, cottages and snowy peaks, hills behind
Match edges, watch it come alive: a forest has just closed on today's acre: birds lift from the 3D trees and bonus points show above the board
Landscape jigsaws to piece together: Worlds, an acre of Meadow Valley in 3D: a river piece over its gap with gold sides, one dotted piece not yet in place
A country lane through every world: Snowbury's snowy lane in 3D: houses and lamps along it, the next acre gold with a flag and a little cart, snow in the air
Worlds for every season: the gallery of finished worlds, each in its season: Snowbury, a snowy market town, then Russet Vale in autumn
A medal for every acre: Oak Haven complete: Gold on the result card, the finished 3D acre above it under a sunset sky

features: Match forests with forests and lakes with lakes, and close regions for bonus points.
Painted 3D tiles: woods, wheat fields, lakes, cottages and snow-capped peaks, on a little island with the countryside behind it.
Beat the day's target for a medal, keep your streak, and share your finished acre. Friends can play the same acre and see both side by side.
Worlds: landscapes to piece together at your own pace, each in its own season. Every world is free.
Cozy acoustic music, festivals, tile colours and a dark mode. Plays fully offline.

money.title: Fair and simple
money.text: Free to play, with a few ads that never interrupt the daily acre. Tiny Acres Plus is one optional, one-time purchase that removes them. No subscription, no in-game currency, no loot boxes.

products.name: Big Deal
products.pitch: One large-print solitaire deal a day.
products.description: The same deal for everyone, checked by computer so it can always be finished. No timer, and unlimited undo.

screenshots.alt: Large print. One deal a day: a solitaire table with big, clear cards, Deal #16, Gentle Monday, par 165.
Tap to move. No clock: a hint suggests moving the three of spades to column 3.
Finish under par for gold: won in 150 moves, par 165, with a gold medal and a 16-day streak.
Every deal checked by computer: the home screen with today's deal and the last seven days.
Readable your way: settings for card size, a four-colour deck, high-contrast cards and a left-handed layout.

features: Large print, in the card size you like: Normal, Large or Extra large.
A four-colour deck, high-contrast cards and a left-handed layout, if you want them.
Tap a card to move it. No clock, and undo as often as you like.
Finish under par for a gold medal, and keep your streak going.
Play past deals from the archive.

money.title: Fair and simple
money.text: Free to play, with a few ads that never appear inside a deal. The first hint in each deal is free. Remove all ads is one optional, one-time purchase. No subscription, no in-game currency, no loot boxes.

products.name: TravelCharika
products.pitch: When to go, and where to book.
products.description: A travel website and apps for Android and iPhone. Each place's twelve months are scored from ten years of measured weather and the holidays that crowd it, so you can see the best time to go.

channels.label: iPhone app
channels.cta: iPhone app on the App Store

features: Every place's twelve months, scored from ten years of measured weather and the public holidays that crowd it.
Which months are good for hiking, the sea, skiing and the northern lights.
The big festivals, carnivals and markets, month by month.
Where to book, once you know when to go.

money.title: How it's paid for
money.text: TravelCharika is free to use. Some of the booking sites it lists pay it a commission; that never decides which sites are listed or in what order.
